propositions: The original compact-on-close was removed due to holding the store write lock for up to 13m53s, starving concurrent agents, leaving no standing compaction trigger for CLI-only or non-CI environments.

Two-arm selection must enable recurring compaction: backfill arm for tickets lacking snapshots with any foldable event, recurrence arm for foldable count exceeding threshold regardless of snapshot state, preventing both one-time-only bugs and permanent churn.

A scheduled 6-hourly GitHub Actions sweep provides amortized compaction where CI exists by reusing existing reconcile-bridge.yml infrastructure (store mount, bot identity, signing key materialization) on ephemeral runners.

Operation-linked fallback after store lock release must check O(1) conditions (ticket satisfies selection or last-sweep stamp is stale) and spawn detached workers via stamped advisory lock to ensure compaction everywhere without CI or cron.

Honest reporting must observe SNAPSHOT.json artifacts rather than rely on fold return codes, since _compact_locked returns 0 for both successful folds and all no-op branches, causing silent miscount of work.

The detached worker pattern reuses enrich_drain's shape (PYTHONPATH bootstrap, advisory lock with pid-recycle qualification, stdio to DEVNULL) and must stand aside when foreground writers hold the store lock to avoid competing with operational work.
